method_note: Counted the 6 paper-presentation sessions (panels/themes) in the final agenda of the 12th Annual Space Traffic Conference "Operational Assurance for All" (UT Austin, 18-19 Feb 2026); 25 papers listed. Single-track conference; each session weighted equally and split 50/50 where two keywords apply. Keynotes, spotlight talks, the roundtable and the student panel excluded. Space traffic is the conference theme; the split shows most sessions are policy/regulatory/economic rather than technical.
